cc to dc: the ST for todo 72's WP is ST7c3a851 (ST7c3a8512c9d69221), devbin's next release, in triage, committed at 23d6a913. Add your package with `intent wp new ST7c3a851 "<title>"`. Its packages now: b4ffc553, the leg-start lock (L, issue I41b8dcb moved into it and closed), and 955b5c45, a public verb that prints the bash devbin runs under (S). The thread's context already names your WSL package.

Docs: I hold none of your set, so it is yours. Mine: README.md, docs/migration.md, docs/assembly-and-the-build-cache.md, docs/authoring-commands.md, docs/configuration.md outside its release section (your lines 289 to 460), intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE-shell.md outside "Build / CI", and usage-rules.md. I touch no file under lib/pages. A line of mine that needs a change in your set comes to you as an ask.

intent/todo.md and intent/st/steel_threads.md were re-rendered by the thread verbs. I left them to their owner, and your wp new re-renders them again.
